notes.title: SKADER is free!
notes.notes:
Happy New Year and happy news right from the start. We made SKADER free for everyone to enjoy. Cyber Skate Warriors: join the freevolution today, SKADER Freevolution has begun!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43096793/f4377c0f054658ce764f2f83676a967a033a627f.jpg[/img]

A sci-fi VR MOBA with unique ice-skating locomotion and a trail generator device to catch your enemies. Are you ready to ditch the VR joystick and use your body movement and real-world physics to glide through the virtual world like never before?

notes.title: Call for Skaders!
notes.notes:
Get ready for an exciting new adventure! We're thrilled to announce that Skader, our latest action-packed game, has been released!

Our Multiverse is collapsing, and only one ancient artifact can save a single universe from destruction. The multiverse sentinels have organized an epic tournament to decide which universe will receive the artifact, and you are one of the chosen warriors to represent your universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43096793/4f8868b87fd2b178c76b5cccfde60603a5d22588.png[/img]

Equipped with a high-end skating device, a helmet, and a trail generator, you'll compete in a battle arena filled with sophisticated features, power-ups, and the artifact itself. Your unique skill, gifted to you by your universe, gives you an advantage over the other warriors. Will you be the one to claim the artifact and save your universe from certain collapse?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43096793/ab4bf7e965225c1dc6d8fcc84695456b588d67de.png[/img]

Skader offers a unique ice-skating VR locomotion system that's easy to start but hard to master. With singleplayer mode, you can play versus bots to hone your skills, or test your skills against real players from all over the world in multiplayer mode. Use the voice chat feature to share your excitement with other players in real-time and strategize for victory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43096793/842a8795b22f20815f49472dd879711927c2a4af.png[/img]

With short game sessions and a complete tutorial, you'll quickly learn the controls and capabilities of your cyborg, allowing you to get the most from your unique skill. Each game gives you experience, virtual currency, and level-ups, and changes your position in the leaderboard, which is visible to all players. With trails, power-ups, and weapons for dynamic gameplay, Skader offers endless hours of fun!

See you in the gameow 🐱

notes.title: Skader Fridays!
notes.notes:
Attention Skaders, pros and beginners! Get ready for an epic multiplayer event that will take your skills to the next level. Join us for a thrilling game of tag on ice-skates. The more players we have the better!  

But that's not all - we'll be teaching some awesome skading tricks that will give you a competitive edge on the battlefield. And if you're up for a challenge, we'll be sharing some secrets that will help you dominate your opponents.  

And the real excitement comes from playing against other players instead of bots. Feel the rush of adrenaline as you race to snatch the feline and avoid other players yourself.  

So gather your friends and get ready to face off against some tough competition. If you're looking for a skading challenge, look no further - this is the event for you. Don't miss out on the fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43096793/66e7167aefd992ee73f432a1e4830b21efb1ce9c.png[/img]

notes.title: Call for beta Skaders!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43096793/77931b3a7904060f974f8b63335b519f19b20615.png[/img]

The game is in active development and we have already completed amazing ice-skating locomotion, a space arena, and a set of powerful power-ups. We are ready to invite a limited number of players to join our closed beta test

[previewyoutube=x_E8LStkjE8;full][/previewyoutube]

The closed beta-test group is open for a limited number of players. Every active beta-testers will get a free copy of the game once released. Please join the game Discord and join the beta group:

[url=https://discord.gg/Dn7RPDZBMz]https://discord.gg/Dn7RPDZBMz[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43096793/2af869c47797c102833afd8a5d74e94f367530b0.png[/img]

We have daily builds released with the community growing, we want you onboard to let us know if we need to change something in the game before the release. This is the best time to shape the game and you can be part of it. Everyone is welcome!
